diagnostics.message: module.webhook-github-app:resource.null_resource.update_app runs a local-exec provisioner that registers the GitHub App webhook at var.webhook_endpoint, but its only dependency on the API Gateway is through the endpoint URL, which references aws_apigatewayv2_api.webhook — not aws_apigatewayv2_stage.webhook. The $default stage is what deploys the route/integration so the endpoint actually serves requests (and accepts GitHub's validation ping); nothing in the graph orders the stage before the webhook registration. Add depends_on = [aws_apigatewayv2_stage.webhook] (via the runners module webhook output) so the stage is deployed before the GitHub App webhook is (re)configured.
